title: The Ascetic, the Ghee, and the Honey
plan_warnings: Four of eight scenes play inside the thought cloud at small scale: figures there are about 150 world units tall; at zoom 1.4 that is over 200 px on screen, but check phone legibility on stills, and keep dream pictograms bold and few on screen at once.
The sit and kneel poses and the costume layer do not exist yet in the Library; this film cannot be staged without them. Build and approve them first (they are shared with AN-095, KD-009, KD-010).
P7 has no pause long enough for effects; the crash at 139.40 sits on a word boundary and must be short (under 0.2 s) and quiet, or dropped if it touches the word.
Stage 4 of the cloud hides the window and lamp; make sure the room still reads as the same hut (keep the mat, floor line and roof beam visible).
The asset list is long (hutRoom, hangingJar, goat, dreamProps, gooSpill plus planned shared assets); dreamProps can be cut down to stall, field, house, slate and palace if time is short.
